address: 6315 Prince Sultan Road, As Salamah, Jeddah, 23446, Saudi Arabia
bio: As you enter, you’re warmly greeted by a smiling team who offer you fresh dates and Saudi coffee, also known as gahwa. Modernity is found throughout, from the interior design to the food. Grab a cosy side seat and order from a menu filled with a mix of contemporary and classical Saudi plates, all bursting with flavour. Order Josper-grilled meats and shellfish, like their tasty roasted prawns with mint sauce, or rich, fruity lamb with Hijazi debyaza served with freshly baked bread. Finish off with their specialty dessert, their twist on a traditional Om Ali dessert.
